title: Prime Minister shares an article by former Principal Secretary to the PM Shri Nripendra Misra highlighting PM Modi's approach to governance and leadership
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by former Principal Secretary to the PM, Shri Nripendra Misra.
In the article, Shri Nripendra Misra writes that the Prime Minister's leadership is best understood through his method. It highlights how his focus on preparation, decisive action and finding solutions has shaped his approach to governance and outcomes.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X:
“PM @narendramodi's leadership is best understood through his method, writes former Principal Secretary to the PM, Shri Nripendra Misra. His focus on preparation, decisive action and finding solutions has shaped his approach to governance and outcomes.”
